headline: India-New Zealand FTA to Take Effect From October 20, Piyush Goyal Says
summary: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said the India-New Zealand free trade agreement will come into force on October 20. Indian exports to New Zealand will receive 100% duty-free access, and New Zealand will invest $20 billion in India over 15 years.
why: Free trade agreements remove tariffs and can expand export volumes for affected sectors, while investment commitments shape long-term capital flows between the two economies.
